name: 砂漠の砂地
notes: Golden sand with broad reconstructed hollows. The first QEM mesh stalled at ~44k triangles, so revision 04 resamples the source upper/lower BVH surface with measured error (near p95 0.019 m), retaining the source relief at a documented fourfold vertical placement scale. Projected reference uses the background-removed image and an alpha-checked interior quadrilateral. Failed revision 03 with background contamination is retained. Two zero-area side endpoints and two coincident underside edges are documented, not claimed watertight; the 65x65 walking surface has no missing samples.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2; preserved dense reconstruction, source-derived reduction and separate revisions.
